findings.title: DOM redaction misses signed URLs in attributes outside the allowlist
findings.evidence: providerEvidenceRedaction.ts:47 strips URL queries only for the exact attribute names href, src, srcset, action, formaction and poster. Probe at head: redactProviderPortalHtml('<svg><use xlink:href="https://x.com/s.svg?sig=SECRET1#frag"></use></svg>') comes back unchanged. In data-* URLs, a query is removed only when the text rules happen to match a parameter named token, session, authorization or cookie, so a CloudFront-style Signature= or Key-Pair-Id= in data-src would survive. Visible names and addresses pass, which is already acknowledged. The letter of AC5 (the kernel rules are applied) is met.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip the query and fragment from any attribute value that parses as an absolute URL, or record this gap in child (b).
